_origin: Template hygiene pass. startup/air_compressor held two genuinely different machines under one key — AIR DRYERS (18 items, ×2) and AIR COMPRESSOR (28 items). The mapping was a batch-time convenience.
_note: BASE-ONLY, minimal defs. Drafter field-def table rides the next batch. A dryer is not a compressor: it removes moisture downstream of one, has its own dewpoint duty, and fails in a way a compressor does not.

mint.name: Compressed Air Dryer
mint.why: Distinct machine, distinct duty, distinct failure mode. Its start-up is a dewpoint and a drain, not a discharge pressure and a receiver.
